title: Marco Rubio on UAPs: From Senate Inquiry to “It’s Classified”
author: André Skondras
summary: In an August 11 interview published by the U.S. Department of State, Marco Rubio said unidentified objects have been observed over U.S. military installations, that he does not know what they are, and that the subject warrants serious investigation. He also said he had handed the UAP portfolio to Stephen Miller and rejected the idea that the current administration is concealing definitive evidence, while The UFO Chronicles uses those remarks to contrast Rubio’s current public tone with his earlier Senate-era UAP involvement.
